description: Relative path of the kept copy of an externally changed file: `<stem>.conflict-<STAMP>.<ext>` where STAMP is UTC YYYYMMDD-HHMM (tests replace the live stamp with the literal STAMP). The Rust side never avoids an existing copy; TS adds -2, -3 (see collisions). `rustExpected` documents known Rust behaviour that differs from `expected`.

names.note: Rust splits at the last '.' of the whole relative path, so a dot in a directory name with an extension-less file puts the stamp inside the directory name.

collisions.description: TS only: with N copies already present the next free name gets -2, -3, ... before the extension.
